name: MelbaVR
summary: MelbaVR invites you into a stunning virtual jungle where you embody a powerful gorilla fighting against human threats. With captivating VR graphics and intuitive controls, swing through trees, roar defiantly, and navigate perilous challenges. Explore a rich narrative, forge alliances, and confront moral dilemmas. Whether a VR enthusiast or novice, experience adrenaline-pumping gameplay and endless adventure. Answer the call of the wild and become the jungle's hero in MelbaVR.
